prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an original PhotoStore desktop video timeline design and architecture reference board, 16:9 landscape, crisp legible neutral dark gray UI, subdued blue selection. No characters, private artwork, product logos, or input images. Main upper 75%: editing interface showing a synthetic preview of simple colored geometric shapes, visible Play/Pause, timecode 00:00:03:12, compact one-row toolbar and pinned ruler with playhead at same time, fixed resizable track gutter, clean video thumbnail lane, still-image lane, nested editable Smart Object lane and real-looking schematic audio waveform lane. Separate selected-clip inspector with transform key diamonds. Media bin has source identities shared by two clip instances and an Offline item with Relink. Small quality menu Original / Half / Quarter / Disk Proxy with status. Settings overflow includes proxy cache limit and Clear Derived Cache. No enormous forms below each layer; clean functional Japanese-compatible label spacing; use English exact labels 'Video Timeline', 'Source', 'Relink', 'Preview Quality', 'Disk Proxy', 'Originals for Export'. Lower 25%: simple architecture workflow diagram with readable boxes 'Source Asset + Revision' -> 'Rational Project Clock' -> 'Shared Time Evaluator' -> 'Preview / Audio / Export', and 'Derived Cache: 256 MiB' plus 'Disk Proxies: 10 GiB'. Show current desired frame changing with playhead and a small discrete 'Loading frame' status, never showing stale frame as current. Label the entire board 'DESIGN REFERENCE — NOT A PRODUCT SCREENSHOT'. This is an implementation reference for fixing frozen playback, stable persisted source references, rational clocks, safe relink, opt-in proxies and shared bounded caches. Do not imply performance benchmarks have passed.
inspection: Inspected before implementation. Useful hierarchy, explicit quality/offline/relink and shared architecture flow. Synthetic geometry only; no private artwork or characters. Designs are not app screenshots or verification. Locks/glyphs/proportions are illustrative. Originals for Export is an invariant in implementation, not a switch allowing proxy export. Audio timing labels and frame count are illustrative, not proof of sample-clock accuracy. 256MiB labels refer to derived cache accounting, not all process memory.
